name: Pan
origin: Greek; goat-god, son of Amalthea and Hermes in some legends, also Zeus' foster brother.

name: Gaea
origin: Greek mother earth goddess who brought Zeus to Crete.

name: Ida Facula
origin: Greek; mountain where Zeus played as a child.

name: Lyctos Facula
origin: Greek; area in Crete where Zeus was raised.
